easy.def: The words people use to talk and write.

more.def: A system of words that people use to speak, write, and understand each other.
more.example: She can speak three languages: English, French, and Arabic.

easy.example: I heard laughter from the playground.

more.def: The sound or act of laughing.
more.example: The room filled with laughter when the clown came in.

easy.def: Not wanting to work or move.
easy.example: The lazy cat slept all day.

more.def: Not willing to work or use energy.
more.example: He felt too lazy to get up and close the door.

easy.def: The person in front who shows the way.
easy.example: Today I am the line leader.

more.def: A person who guides or is in charge of a group.
more.example: A good leader listens to everyone on the team.

easy.def: A very old story that people still tell.
easy.example: There is a legend about a dragon in this cave.

more.def: An old story passed down over many years that may or may not be true.
more.example: According to legend, a giant made these hills.

easy.def: A place with lots of books you can borrow.
easy.example: I got a book from the library.

more.def: A place where books and other materials are kept for people to read or borrow.
more.example: We go to the library every Saturday to choose new books.

easy.def: A bright flash of light in the sky in a storm.
easy.example: I saw lightning and then heard thunder.

more.def: A bright flash of electricity in the sky during a storm.
more.example: Lightning lit up the whole sky for a second.

easy.def: Something wet that you can pour.

more.def: Something that flows and can be poured, like water. It is not a solid or a gas.
more.example: When ice melts, it changes from a solid into a liquid.

easy.def: To use your ears to hear.

more.def: To pay attention so that you can hear something.
more.example: If you listen closely, you can hear the ocean from here.

easy.def: Sad because you are by yourself.
easy.example: The new kid felt lonely at lunch.

more.def: Feeling sad because you are alone or have no one to talk to.
more.example: He felt lonely after his best friend moved away.

easy.example: My dog is loyal to me.

more.def: Always faithful and true to a person, group, or idea.
more.example: A loyal friend stands by you even when things are hard.

easy.def: Having good things happen to you.
easy.example: I was lucky to find a coin.

more.def: Having good things happen by chance.
more.example: We were lucky that the rain stopped just before the game.
